title: Hash set: keep first occurrences
summary: Deduplicate hashable values from a stream in encounter order. Yield a value only when it first enters the seen set.
triggers: deduplicate a stream without sorting it
prompts: Emit the first check-in for each badge ID in a day’s event stream.
Remove repeated package names while keeping the first appearance of each name.
invariant: The set contains exactly the distinct items consumed so far.
mantra: Remember the key before yielding it.
pitfalls: Iterating the set at the end would lose the encounter order.

anchors.name: Contains Duplicate
anchors.trick: A membership check reveals when a value has already appeared.

mutations.explanation: Never records a first occurrence, so duplicates pass through.
